title: KP bundle and application isolation
summary: Measure and reduce selected-experience closure, repair the place-value budget structurally, and isolate Internal Studio and Public Web entry graphs without weakening the framework-neutral kernel.

expectedLearning: Which exact feature packs and application owners dominate each selected experience rather than the aggregate catalogue.
Whether Internal Studio and Public Web can own isolated production entry graphs while sharing one framework-neutral KP kernel.
allowedWork: The ordered twelve-part bundle and application isolation tranche recorded in the approved ownership proposal, after a dedicated long-loop contract is reviewed and approved.
disallowedWork: No SvelteKit adoption, physical package extraction, visible choreography changes, curriculum expansion, or mutation of user-owned economics authoring files.
